import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet');c='count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL'
w['r']=w[c]/w.n_passages;w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int)
print(w.year.isna().sum(), w.r.mean())
def est(d):
    g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack().dropna()
    return (g[1]-g[0]).mean()
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
def boot(d,B=1000):
    e=est(d);bs=[]
    gs=[x for _,x in d.groupby(['genre','late'])]
    for _ in range(B):
        bs.append(est(pd.concat([x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)) for x in gs])))
    return e,np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5])
print('all',boot(w))
print('high',boot(w[w.date_confidence=='high']))
print(pd.crosstab(w.genre,w.late));print(pd.crosstab(w.date_confidence,w.late,normalize='columns'));print(pd.crosstab(w.origin,w.late,normalize='columns'))
print(w.groupby('late').n_editions.mean())
w['ap']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count');print(w.groupby('late').ap.mean())
print(w.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack())
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean())
m=smf.ols('r~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+np.log(n_editions)+np.log(ap)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':w.author_key.astype('category').cat.codes});print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'].values)
for o in ['UK','US','unknown']: print(o,boot(w[w.origin==o],300))
